scripts.dev: pnpm run setup:native && pnpm run patch:novnc && pnpm --filter @vnc-cua/contracts build && concurrently -n contracts,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @vnc-cua/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @vnc-cua/server dev" "pnpm --filter @vnc-cua/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm run setup:native && pnpm run patch:novnc && pnpm --filter @vnc-cua/contracts build && pnpm -r test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run patch:novnc && pnpm --filter @vnc-cua/contracts build && pnpm -r typecheck
